overview.zh: 这张图展开上位机 start_controller 的使能流程：UI 请求先经过设备检查、通信连接、通道可用性、急停与 P4 状态门槛，再由当前模式选择关节反馈启动或电机直接保持。每个 guard 都对应一个可拒绝启动的早退分支。
overview.en: This graph expands the desktop start_controller enable path. The request passes device checks, serial connectivity, channel availability, E-stop and P4-state gates before the active mode selects joint feedback control or direct motor hold. Each guard is an early-return path that can reject startup.
